positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (18.1): 1.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 69 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 460 m, Newton MRT about 1,150 m; closer than 236 of 551 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 820 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 270 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 1,310 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 940 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 720 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 840 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,590 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,890 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 356 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 28 new sales and 870 resales (898 purchases); new sales were 3.1% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 870 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 206 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 870 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 893 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−2.6%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
